content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 carries approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies for LDC/JSA and DEO posts combined. The notice states that final vacancies, along with the post-wise and category-wise break-up, will be published later on the SSC website under Candidate's Corner > Tentative Vacancy. State-wise or zone-wise vacancy figures are not compiled by the Commission; candidates are advised to contact the respective User Departments for that information.

content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is assessed as on the cut-off date of 07 October 2026, and covers nationality, educational qualification, and age. A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from certain specified countries with the intention of settling permanently in India (candidates in the latter categories require an eligibility certificate from the Government of India). Candidates who have appeared for their Class 12 exam can also apply, but they must have the qualifying result declared on or before 07 October 2026. Only a declared result counts - a result "under process" does not meet the requirement.

content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 27 years, reckoned as on 01 August 2026. This means candidates born not before 02 August 1999 and not later than 01 August 2008 are eligible to apply. Age relaxation is available as per government norms. Only male candidates are eligible for any vacancies reported in the Border Roads Organization (BRO). To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 100. Women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) categories eligible for reservation are exempted from the fee. Fee can be paid online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Visa/MasterCard/Maestro/RuPay debit cards, up to 08 October 2026 (23:00 Hours). Fee once paid is not refundable or adjustable against any other exam.

content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is through a Computer Based Examination conducted in two tiers. Tier-I consists of objective type, multiple-choice questions only, with a total duration of 60 minutes and negative marking of 0.50 marks per wrong answer. Tier-II is conducted in two sessions on the same day, comprising four sections: Section-I (Mathematical Abilities and Reasoning & General Intelligence), Section-II (English Language & Comprehension and General Awareness), Section-III (Computer Knowledge Test, qualifying in nature), and Section-IV (Skill Test/Typing Test for DEO and LDC/JSA posts respectively). It is mandatory to qualify all sections of Tier-II. There is negative marking of 1 mark per wrong answer in Sections I and II. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in or the "my SSC" mobile application. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website - OTR generated on the earlier website will not work here. Log in and fill out the SSC CHSL 2026 online application form. Opt for Aadhaar-based authentication during OTR, if desired, to simplify photo/ID requirements at the exam venue. Upload the required details and capture your photograph as per the instructions in the application module. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) before 08 October 2026. Submit the form and keep a printout for your records.

content_sections.heading: SSC CHSL Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in online mode; no offline applications are accepted. Candidates can select up to three exam centres in order of priority. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other exam. The correction window (14–16 October 2026) allows a maximum of two modifications/re-submissions to the application; only applications with fee received (or fee-exempted) are eligible for correction. Applications remaining "Incomplete" due to non-receipt of fee will be summarily rejected. The Tier-I and Tier-II exam schedule will be announced separately.

faq.question: Q1. What is SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Staff Selection Commission for the Combined Higher Secondary Level (10+2) Examination 2026, filling LDC/JSA and DEO/DEO Grade 'A' posts across various Central Government Ministries and Departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: Approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies, combined across LDC/JSA and DEO posts. Final and post-wise numbers will be released later.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours) is the last date to submit the online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: Class 12 pass or equivalent from a recognised Board; for DEO posts in specific departments, 12th Standard in Science with Mathematics is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: 18 to 27 years as on 01 August 2026, with age relaxation for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 100, with women, SC, ST, PwBD, and ESM candidates exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: By completing One-Time Registration and the application form at ssc.gov.in, or through the "my SSC" mobile app.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SSC CHSL 2026?
faq.answer: A two-tier Computer Based Examination - Tier-I (objective type, four subjects) and Tier-II (four sections including a Skill/Typing Test), followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for SSC CHSL posts?
faq.answer: LDC/JSA: Pay Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200); DEO: Pay Level-4/5 (Rs. 25,500–81,100 / Rs. 29,200–92,300); DEO Grade 'A': Pay Level-4 (Rs. 25,500–81,100). In-hand salary is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. When will the SSC CHSL 2026 exam be held?
faq.answer: The Tier-I and Tier-II exam dates are not specified in the notification and will be announced later on the SSC website.
